title: Apple-derived operational quality
scope: 13 operational depth enrichments; no claim of exhaustive HIG coverage or actual runtime acceptance

patterns.name: HIG selective source routing / roteamento de conhecimento
patterns.behavior: Select foundations, platform and task article; bounded related expansion; classify primary guidance vs interpretation.
patterns.acceptance: Trace each recommendation to source, version, platform or project choice; no ungrounded native-to-web rules.
patterns.evidence_status: Independent operational enrichment from reviewed skill entrypoints; proposed acceptance checks, runtime not executed.
patterns.classification: operational enrichment, not a novel universal pattern

patterns.name: Continuous adaptive resize / redimensionamento contínuo
patterns.behavior: Container-local constraints, stable state, collapse order and focus recovery.
patterns.acceptance: Narrow-wide-narrow, zoom, long labels, splitter cancel; preserve selection, scroll and draft.
patterns.evidence_status: Independent operational enrichment from reviewed skill entrypoints; proposed acceptance checks, runtime not executed.
patterns.classification: operational enrichment, not a novel universal pattern

patterns.name: Toolbar priority and overflow / prioridade de comandos
patterns.behavior: Explicit command groups and deterministic overflow with essential actions reachable.
patterns.acceptance: Test width thresholds, localization, keyboard/touch, anchor and focus return.
patterns.evidence_status: Independent operational enrichment from reviewed skill entrypoints; proposed acceptance checks, runtime not executed.
patterns.classification: operational enrichment, not a novel universal pattern

patterns.name: Window, tab and panel lifecycle / restauração do workspace
patterns.behavior: Separate object identity, view instance and durable state; dispose on close.
patterns.acceptance: Test duplicate opening, reopen, restore, scope isolation, close active and history.
patterns.evidence_status: Independent operational enrichment from reviewed skill entrypoints; proposed acceptance checks, runtime not executed.
patterns.classification: operational enrichment, not a novel universal pattern

patterns.name: Document autosave, undo and recovery / recuperação de documentos
patterns.behavior: Revision-guard saves, recoverable drafts, undo scope, conflict handling.
patterns.acceptance: Test edit during save, offline, retry, conflict and reload; no false saved state.
patterns.evidence_status: Independent operational enrichment from reviewed skill entrypoints; proposed acceptance checks, runtime not executed.
patterns.classification: operational enrichment, not a novel universal pattern

patterns.name: Multimodal gesture ownership / conflitos de gestos
patterns.behavior: Define precedence of press, scroll, drag, pinch and selection; provide alternative inputs.
patterns.acceptance: Test pointercancel, nested scrolling, long press, keyboard reorder, no duplicate action.
patterns.evidence_status: Independent operational enrichment from reviewed skill entrypoints; proposed acceptance checks, runtime not executed.
patterns.classification: operational enrichment, not a novel universal pattern

patterns.name: Runtime accessibility evidence / acessibilidade real
patterns.behavior: Automated and manual semantic, keyboard, assistive technology and composited contrast checks.
patterns.acceptance: Record tested AT/version, focus, reflow, reduced motion, failures and not-run checks.
patterns.evidence_status: Independent operational enrichment from reviewed skill entrypoints; proposed acceptance checks, runtime not executed.
patterns.classification: operational enrichment, not a novel universal pattern

patterns.name: Functional visual evidence / captura e comportamento
patterns.behavior: Bind deployed revision, fixture, screenshot, semantic tree, interaction assertion and logs.
patterns.acceptance: Reproduce requested state and verify behavior; screenshot alone not proof.
patterns.evidence_status: Independent operational enrichment from reviewed skill entrypoints; proposed acceptance checks, runtime not executed.
patterns.classification: operational enrichment, not a novel universal pattern

patterns.name: Comparable performance profiling / medição de desempenho
patterns.behavior: Repeat same workload and environment; preserve raw samples, distinguish hypotheses from measurement.
patterns.acceptance: Baseline vs candidate with correctness, cancellation, variance and explicit attribution.
patterns.evidence_status: Independent operational enrichment from reviewed skill entrypoints; proposed acceptance checks, runtime not executed.
patterns.classification: operational enrichment, not a novel universal pattern

patterns.name: Privacy-bounded telemetry / telemetria com privacidade
patterns.behavior: Typed allowlist, low-cardinality metadata, bounded retention and authorized export.
patterns.acceptance: Assert no private payload, unknown fields or unintended network export.
patterns.evidence_status: Independent operational enrichment from reviewed skill entrypoints; proposed acceptance checks, runtime not executed.
patterns.classification: operational enrichment, not a novel universal pattern

patterns.name: Agent action contracts / ferramentas de IA
patterns.behavior: Stable identifiers, typed schemas, deterministic authority, side effects and idempotency.
patterns.acceptance: Test duplicate request, cancellation, stale outputs, permissions, uncertain outcome reconciliation.
patterns.evidence_status: Independent operational enrichment from reviewed skill entrypoints; proposed acceptance checks, runtime not executed.
patterns.classification: operational enrichment, not a novel universal pattern

patterns.name: Agent action evaluation / avaliação de agentes
patterns.behavior: Versioned fixtures test tool selection, arguments, forbidden effects, fallback and schema.
patterns.acceptance: Isolated fixtures with hidden labels, record denominator and failures; separate retrieval metrics.
patterns.evidence_status: Independent operational enrichment from reviewed skill entrypoints; proposed acceptance checks, runtime not executed.
patterns.classification: operational enrichment, not a novel universal pattern

patterns.name: Conversation transcript lifecycle / gerenciamento de contexto
patterns.behavior: Selective skill loading, compact completed exchanges, preserve durable decisions and pending calls.
patterns.acceptance: Measure token/latency and context-loss regressions in long sessions; preserve authorization boundaries.
patterns.evidence_status: Independent operational enrichment from reviewed skill entrypoints; proposed acceptance checks, runtime not executed.
patterns.classification: operational enrichment, not a novel universal pattern
